mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_field_definition ( tenant_id, field_id, value_type, owner_name, provenance, classification, allowed_uses, max_age_seconds, null_policy, missing_policy, retention_days, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{fieldId}, #{valueType}, #{ownerName}, #{provenance}, #{classification}, #{allowedUses}, #{maxAgeSeconds}, #{nullPolicy}, #{missingPolicy}, #{retentionDays}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT field_id AS fieldId, value_type AS valueType, owner_name AS ownerName, provenance, classification, allowed_uses AS allowedUses, max_age_seconds AS maxAgeSeconds, null_policy AS nullPolicy, missing_policy AS missingPolicy, retention_days AS retentionDays FROM mk_field_definition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY field_id

SELECT field_id AS fieldId, value_type AS valueType FROM mk_field_definition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND field_id IN
#{fieldId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_segment_definition ( tenant_id, segment_id, version_no, name, rule_json, rule_hash, state_name, created_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{segmentId}, #{versionNo}, #{name}, #{ruleJson}, #{ruleHash}, #{stateName}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT current.segment_id AS segmentId, current.version_no AS versionNo, current.name, current.state_name AS stateName, current.rule_json AS ruleJson, current.rule_hash AS ruleHash, current.created_at AS createdAt FROM mk_segment_definition current WHERE current.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND current.version_no = ( SELECT MAX(latest.version_no) FROM mk_segment_definition latest WHERE latest.tenant_id = current.tenant_id AND latest.segment_id = current.segment_id ) ORDER BY current.name, current.segment_id

SELECT segment_id AS segmentId, version_no AS versionNo, name, state_name AS stateName, rule_json AS ruleJson, rule_hash AS ruleHash, created_at AS createdAt FROM mk_segment_definition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND segment_id = #{segmentId} AND version_no = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_audience_snapshot ( tenant_id, snapshot_id, segment_id, segment_version, as_of_time, watermark_time, expires_at, member_count, checksum, state_name, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{snapshotId}, #{segmentId}, #{segmentVersion}, #{asOfTime}, #{watermarkTime}, #{expiresAt}, #{memberCount}, #{checksum}, #{stateName}, #{createdAt} )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_audience_member ( tenant_id, snapshot_id, subject_hash, membership_version, active_value, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{snapshotId}, #{subjectHash}, #{membershipVersion}, #{activeValue}, #{updatedAt} )
